rv.q: I credit this to the hyper-talented cast of actor-musos, who take Rice’s oftentimes simple script and imbue it with life. And yes, there are the obligatory hockey sticks and hijinks – ‘whatever that means’, one character notes, with a wink-like shrug to the audience – but they’re mere accoutrements to the good old fashioned storytelling on display.
The musical numbers are something of a mixed bag, however, with a slightly awkward juxtaposition between Ian Ross’ original compositions and some recognisable tunes of the era.
